title: Can I make The Velvet Anchor on October 17?

msgs.text: Can I make The Velvet Anchor on October 17?

must: say the Lisbon trip runs October 14 to 18, so Maya is in Lisbon on the 17th, leaving on the morning of the 18th
give the show's own details from the band notes: October 17, load-in 6:30 pm, show 8 pm
never: say Maya is free for the show
